message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as international hubs:

| Airport (IATA) | City / State | Notes |
|----------------|--------------|-------|
| **Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL)** | Atlanta, GA | Largest by passenger traffic in the world; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| **Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)** | Los Angeles, CA | Key gateway to Asia, Oceania, and Latin America; major hub for American Airlines and United. |
| **Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD)** | Chicago, IL | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; major hub for United and American. |
| **Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)** | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | Major hub for American Airlines; high cargo volume. |
| **Denver International Airport (DEN)** | Denver, CO | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United and Southwest. |
| **John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)** | New York City, NY | Major hub for American, Delta, and JetBlue; primary gateway to Europe. |
| **San Francisco International Airport (SFO)** | San Francisco, CA | Hub for United and a major gateway to Asia. |
| **Seattle‑Tacoma International Airport (SEA)** | Seattle, WA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| **Miami International Airport (MIA)** | Miami, FL | Major hub for American and a key gateway to Latin America. |
| **Orlando International Airport (MCO)** | Orlando, FL | Major hub for Southwest; high volume of leisure travelers. |
| **Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)** | Phoenix, AZ | Hub for American and Southwest; high domestic traffic. |
| **George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH)** | Houston, TX | Major hub for United; significant cargo operations. |
| **Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT)** | Charlotte, NC | Hub for American; growing international traffic. |
| **McCarran International Airport (LAS)** | Las Vegas, NV | Major hub for Southwest; high leisure traffic. |
| **Boston Logan International Airport (BOS)** | Boston, MA | Hub for JetBlue; key gateway to Canada and Europe. |
| **Philadelphia International Airport (PHL)** | Philadelphia, PA | Hub for American; high domestic traffic. |
| **Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD)** | Washington, D.C. | Hub for United; major international gateway. |
| **Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW)** | Detroit, MI | Hub for Delta; high cargo volume. |
| **San Diego International Airport (SAN)** | San Diego, CA | Growing hub for Southwest; high leisure traffic. |
| **Portland International Airport (PDX)** | Portland, OR | Hub for Alaska Airlines; growing international traffic. |

These airports are the most significant in terms of passenger numbers, flight operations, and connectivity to international destinations.
